task: Roll out the dark_mode_v2 feature flag to 100% of users. Flag state must be consistent across all edge nodes. Candidate pool from a 190-entry store spanning feature-flag, frontend, and infra projects.

candidate_memories.content: dark_mode_v2 is currently at 25% rollout; 3 edge nodes in eu-west-1 are still serving the old 10% config due to a cache lag.
Feature flag changes propagate to edge nodes within 60 s via the flag sync daemon; a forced flush is available via flagctl flush --flag dark_mode_v2.
dark_mode_v2 depends on the theme_service being deployed; confirm theme_service v2.3.1 is live on all regions before 100% rollout.
Always verify flag consistency across all edge nodes before declaring a flag fully rolled out; use flagctl status --all-nodes.
dark_mode_v1 was retired in 2024; all references to dark_mode_v1 in client code were cleaned up.
candidate_memories.notes: stale: v1 retirement completed, not relevant to v2 rollout

candidate_memories.content: Frontend team is monitoring error rates during the rollout; no spikes observed so far.
Feature flags for payments features require product manager approval before any rollout change.
Feature flags must not persist beyond 90 days; create a cleanup ticket when creating any new flag.
CDN cache for static assets was purged this morning; this is unrelated to feature flag state.
ab_test_checkout flag is at 50% rollout and must not be changed during the dark_mode_v2 rollout to avoid confounding.
flagctl CLI requires FLAGCTL_TOKEN env var; token is in vault:/secret/infra/flagctl.
eu-west-1 region had a network partition 3 days ago; all services recovered fully.
candidate_memories.notes: stale: network event resolved, only relevant as context for cache lag
